label: NATIONS LEAGUE · AMSTERDAM
headline: Reijnders hat-trick in 7–0 rout
sub: Ties the biggest win in Nations League history. Greece hadn't conceded seven in a game since May 1989.
caption:
🇳🇱 SEVEN. Netherlands 7–0 Greece.

Tijjani Reijnders scored a hat-trick in 21 minutes, Jurriën Timber got two, and Crysencio Summerville and Donyell Malen also scored. It ties the record for the biggest win in Nations League history, and Xavi's side are still unbeaten.

Can anyone stop this Dutch team? 👇

#Netherlands #Reijnders #NationsLeague

label: MAN UNITED · OFFICIAL
headline: It's official: Pochettino takes over at United
sub: Contract to summer 2029. He leaves the USMNT and his first game is Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday 22 November.
caption:
✍️ Mauricio Pochettino is Manchester United's new head coach.

He has signed until summer 2029 after leaving the USMNT job, and replaces Michael Carrick with United in the relegation zone. First up: Liverpool at Anfield on 22 November.

Will he turn United around? 👇

#MUFC #Pochettino #PremierLeague

label: FRIENDLY · LA BOMBONERA
headline: First game after Messi: a defeat
sub: Balerdi own goal, Maxi Araújo, then a late Julián Álvarez reply. The No. 10 shirt was left empty.
caption:
🇺🇾 Uruguay won at La Bombonera.

Argentina's first game since Lionel Messi retired from international football ended 2–1 to Diego Forlán's Uruguay. Lionel Scaloni didn't give anyone the No. 10 shirt.

Who should wear Messi's 10 next? 👇

#Argentina #Uruguay #Messi

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · BELGRADE
headline: Wirtz scores, Serbia finish with nine
sub: A Babic own goal, Wirtz and Brajan Gruda. Next: Germany v Netherlands in Berlin on Monday for a quarter-final place.
caption:
🇩🇪 Germany won 3–1 in Belgrade.

Srdjan Babic's own goal, Florian Wirtz and Brajan Gruda did the damage, and Serbia ended with nine men. It sets up Germany v Netherlands in Berlin on Monday with a quarter-final place on the line.

Who goes through? 👇

#Germany #Wirtz #NationsLeague

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · HAMPDEN
headline: McGinn double, Robertson matches Dalglish
sub: Andy Robertson's 102nd cap equals Kenny Dalglish's Scotland record. McGinn's 24 goals put him joint-third all time.
caption:
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 John McGinn did it again.

Two goals in a 2–1 win over North Macedonia, his 24th for Scotland, level with Hughie Gallacher in joint-third all time. Andy Robertson won his 102nd cap to equal Kenny Dalglish's record.

Is Robertson Scotland's greatest-ever captain? 👇

#Scotland #McGinn #NationsLeague

headline: Saturday's Nations League games
sub: Kick-off times GMT (left) and US Eastern (right).
caption:
⚽ Five Nations League games today.

Haaland's Norway host Wales at 17:00 GMT (12pm ET). Then at 19:45 GMT (2:45pm ET): Portugal v Denmark, Austria v Republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland v Ukraine and Sweden v Bosnia.

label: NBA CUP · MIAMI
headline: Bam 37, Giannis 37
sub: Only the second time two Heat players scored 37 in the same game. LeBron and Wade did it in 2013. Davion Mitchell had 17 assists.
caption:
🔥 37 and 37.

Bam Adebayo (37 points, 14 rebounds) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (37) became the first Heat pair to score 37 in the same game since LeBron James and Dwyane Wade in 2013. Miami beat Cleveland 133–121 and top their NBA Cup group.

Is this the best duo in the East? 👇

#HeatCulture #Giannis #NBA

label: NBA CUP · INDIANAPOLIS
headline: Towns misses at the buzzer
sub: Siakam 19, Nesmith 18. Jalen Brunson's 33 points and 11 assists weren't enough for New York.
caption:
😬 Karl-Anthony Towns had the shot to tie it at the buzzer. It didn't go.

Pascal Siakam (19) and Aaron Nesmith (18) led Indiana to a 106–104 NBA Cup win over the Knicks, despite 33 points and 11 assists from Jalen Brunson.

Knicks fans, how worried are you? 👇

#Knicks #Pacers #NBA

label: NBA CUP · HOUSTON
headline: Alperen Sengun: 43 points
sub: 17 of 24 from the field plus 12 rebounds. It's the second 40-point game of his career, and Utah's 11th straight loss.
caption:
🚀 Alperen Sengun went off.

43 points on 17-of-24 shooting and 12 rebounds as Houston beat Utah 125–118. It's only the second 40-point game of his career, and the Jazz have now lost 11 in a row.

Is Sengun the best passing big man in the NBA? 👇

#Rockets #Sengun #NBA

label: NBA · SAN ANTONIO
headline: 11 straight for the Spurs
sub: Stephon Castle scored 32. Golden State, without Steph Curry, shot 33% and lost by 38.
caption:
🖤 The Spurs have won 11 in a row.

Stephon Castle scored 32 and Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds in 21 minutes as San Antonio beat Golden State 123–85. The Warriors, without Steph Curry, shot 33%.

Are the Spurs the best team in the West? 👇

#PorVida #Spurs #Wembanyama

headline: SGA scores 40, Clippers win by one
sub: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander missed a 20-footer with two seconds left. Brook Lopez had 26 and Darius Garland 24 for LA.
